items.title: Allstate (NYSE:ALL) reports sales below analyst estimates in Q3 2026 earnings
items.summary: Insurance giant Allstate (NYSE:ALL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as revenue rose 2.8% year on year to $17.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $9.76 per share was 40.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Allstate (ALL) Takes Full Ownership Of A Mobility Data Company
items.summary: Allstate (NYSE:ALL) subsidiary Arity is acquiring the remaining ownership interest in mobility intelligence firm Replica. Replica focuses on data and technology for mobility insights that can inform insurance product design and risk assessment. Arity plans to fully integrate Replica's mobility data capabilities into its existing analytics-focused operations.
